mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tournament (id, name, event_date, group_type, format, status, entry_fee, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{eventDate}, #{groupType}, #{format}, #{status}, #{entryFee}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tournament WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE tournament SET name = #{name}, event_date = #{eventDate}, group_type = #{groupType}, format = #{format}, status = #{status}, entry_fee = #{entryFee}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM tournament WHERE name = #{name} AND event_date = #{eventDate} AND deleted = 0
